To install libretro-vice-x64dtv on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-x64dtv-git. It is a 842.6 KB download (2.1 MB installed), version r21255.fdda9d0-1, licensed GPL-2.0-or-later. Commodore C64DTV core. Free and open source.

Install libretro-vice-x64dtv on Omarchy

This VICE-libretro core emulates the Commodore 64 Direct-to-TV (C64DTV), the single-chip, joystick-shaped mini-console Commodore released with games built in. It's part of the same RetroArch port of VICE as the other Commodore cores, offering save states, ZIP/M3U support, and remappable controls. It has no interface of its own — RetroArch is the front end.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-x64dtv-git
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version r21255.fdda9d0-1:
    pacman -Qi libretro-vice-x64dtv-git

Open and use libretro-vice-x64dtv

libretro-vice-x64dtv has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql libretro-vice-x64dtv-git | grep /usr/bin/

libretro-vice-x64dtv requirements and compatibility

  • C64DTV-compatible software/images to run (not included)
  • RetroArch installed to load the core

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • glibc
  • libretro-core-info
  • libstdc++.so

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: GPL-2.0-or-later.

Uninstall libretro-vice-x64dtv

omarchy pkg drop libretro-vice-x64dtv-git

Frequently asked questions

How do I install libretro-vice-x64dtv on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-x64dtv-git. The download is 842.6 KB and it takes 2.1 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is libretro-vice-x64dtv free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL-2.0-or-later.

How do I uninstall libretro-vice-x64dtv?

Run omarchy pkg drop libretro-vice-x64dtv-git. It removes the package from your system.

What does libretro-vice-x64dtv depend on?

The package declares 3 dependencies: glibc, libretro-core-info, libstdc++.so. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is libretro-vice-x64dtv a desktop app?

No. libretro-vice-x64dtv has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is libretro-vice-x64dtv in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as libretro-vice-x64dtv-git (version r21255.fdda9d0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Libretro makes it. Project site: https://github.com/libretro/vice-libretro.
